description: This file is a script for processing and generating content for a developer roadmap project. It reads roadmap data, manages files, and interacts with the OpenAI API to generate topic introductions.

methods.name: getFilesInFolder
methods.description: Recursively reads a folder to build a mapping of relative file URLs to their full paths.

methods.name: writeTopicContent
methods.description: Generates a markdown introduction for a given topic using OpenAI API.

methods.name: writeFileForGroup
methods.description: Writes content to a file for a specific group, generating content via OpenAI if the file is empty.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main function orchestrating the process of reading roadmap data, generating content, and writing files.
